item.title: Man arrested after fire breaks out at Hitler’s former Alpine retreat
item.description:
Man arrested after fire breaks out at Hitler’s former Alpine retreat
A man has been arrested after a fire broke out at Hitler’s former Alpine retreat, the Kehlsteinhaus, on Friday night.

item.title: Argentina drops investigation into President Milei over crypto fraud
item.description:
Argentina drops investigation into President Milei over crypto fraud
Javier Milei had denied acting fraudulently when a cryptocurrency nosedived after he deleted a social media post about it.
